description: Elections Commission - Order under Section 38(3) of the (Local Authority Election Ordinance) Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement and rescheduling of local authority elections in the Kandy district. It references election notifications, nomination periods, poll dates, and funding issues affecting the electoral process. The content falls under the Elections category as it primarily concerns electoral procedures, scheduling, and administrative matters related to local government elections, without involving government personnel appointments or structural changes.
